integrity: An elementary all-parameter proof and finite checker based on direct token moves are included. The checker verifies finite instances only; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only \(F_2(S_{a,b})\) with a,b positive, not token graphs of general trees or larger token numbers; priority among unindexed earlier equivalent formulations is provisional.
title: Exact maximum independent configurations of two-token double stars
